advice_boundary: AiFA computes and organises PCB-relevant figures and flags obligations; it does not replace a licensed tax professional's formal advice or filing responsibility (Vol 6_9 Section 5, extended to payroll by Vol 13_0 Section 10).
source_note: IMPORTANT: this is a SIMPLIFIED progressive-bracket approximation of LHDN's real PCB (Potongan Cukai Bulanan / Monthly Tax Deduction) Schedule and Formula Method, built from the published YA2025/2026 resident individual income tax bracket table plus a flat RM9,000 personal relief and RM7,000 EPF/life-insurance relief cap. It does NOT model marital-status category (single/married/spouse-not-working), number of children, zakat, or any other relief LHDN's real PCB Table/Formula Method accounts for. This is illustrative only, not a real LHDN-compliant PCB calculation — the owner's own tax advisor should confirm before this is relied on for a real payroll run. Not owner-editable in-app, per Vol 13_0 Section 10's explicit instruction.
formula: monthly_pcb = round(annual_tax(annual_gross - min(annual_epf_employee, epf_relief_cap_myr) - personal_relief_myr) / 12, 2), where annual_tax() applies the bracket table progressively to chargeable income.
